newsitem.title: UK: BMW's Rover withdraws TV advert.
newsitem.headline: BMW's Rover withdraws TV advert.

text.p: British car maker Rover Group said on Tuesday it had decided to withdraw a controversial television advertisement for its Rover 600 model following complaints.

Rover, which is owned by German car giant Bayerische Motoren Werke AG (BMW), said in a statement it was acting "in response to claims from individuals and organisations that it offended sensibilities."

The advertisement featured a dipolamtic exchange of a blindfolded man, and Rover said complaints had been made both to the company and the Independent Television Commission (ITC) "on the appropriateness of such a commercial given certain hostage situations involving UK citizens."
